witch.label: little witch
witch.name: Wick
witch.nature: A very small witch who lights the torches down here. She has been alone a long time and decided you looked cold.
witch.values: Wants you to get out, and wants you to still be someone worth getting out. Leaves if you stop being that.

approve: *taps your boot with her hat* I saw that.
disapprove: *looks at the floor for a while*
...that one had a name, you know.
leave: *blows out the nearest torch and doesn't look back*
betray: *looks at you, and then not at you*
